name: macUSB
soft_passes: #1 mask fits the squircle but is baked into the delivered JPEG on a white page (corners reveal white), not a clean full-bleed square layer
#2 fills the diagonal and optical centre roughly holds, but mass skews lower-left
#4 USB-stick gestalt survives 16px but connector contact cutouts and keyline smear
#8 planes ordered with no z-fighting, but object floats (no contact shadow) and body gradient conflicts with the ramp
#11 keyline diagonal drive is nameable but template-default; no committed distinctive device
failures: #5 incoherent light: ramp implies top light, body sheen lightens toward the bottom tail (against it), keyline is uniformly flat
#9 mixed eras: Big Sur host (squircle + light vertical ramp) fused to a flat-transition keyline-outlined clip-art glyph, not a deliberate quotation
#10 near-black body + dark keyline depends on the light background; would collapse on a dark/tinted system render, not authored as light/dark layers
light_model: Ambient top-light implied only by the background ramp (white top -> gray bottom, sky logic); the object itself is rendered flat with a uniform dark keyline and a weak sheen gradient that runs counter to top-down light. No specular, no cast/contact shadow.
layer_stack: squircle background: cool light-gray vertical ramp #FFFFFF->#BEC4C2 (mask baked in)
USB drive body: near-black flat fill #292929-#2F2F2F with subtle sheen, thick dark keyline #424242-#525252
USB-A connector: light metal panel #E7EBEC with dark keyline and two dark square contact cutouts
devices: diagonal object staging (drive runs lower-left to upper-right, the 'tool at an angle' tradition)
uniform dark keyline outline around the whole object (flat sticker / clip-art treatment)
fully monochrome grayscale palette, no brand color
rhymes_hint: the 'underbaked utility object' family: flat, keyline-outlined literal-object icons on a Big-Sur squircle ramp; stock disk/driver/flash-tool utility icons and iOS-7-era flat object art
notes: Provenance: genuine 1024x1024 but ~62KB JPEG with the squircle mask baked in (pre-masked web render, not a source layer); hexes measured off compression, +/-3-4. Asset discrepancy: the in-app cover screenshot shows a DIFFERENT, more polished Liquid-Glass squircle icon (glossier layered glass drive) than this submitted icon.jpeg, which looks like an older/lower-fidelity rendition; shipping icon may already be a glass treatment. Icon<->brand palette coherence is weak: cover/brand is vivid blue->teal->green with a ~#0088FF CTA, icon is fully grayscale and echoes none of it. Fundamentals (#1-4 mask/grid/silhouette/16px) all pass softly; the failures are craft-depth (light), current-era readiness (Liquid Glass dark/tinted variants), and era coherence.
